mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 7.0% for 3 consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0% for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) for 3 consecutive months indicates severe housing sector contraction, which precedes broader economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS and HOUST decline for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During early recession phases characterized by industrial production below 100 (2017=100), manufacturing sector weakness compresses corporate margins and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) signals strong consumer confidence and housing market health, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings benefit from economic expansion.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 95 for two consecutive months indicates severe supply chain disruption that compresses corporate margins and reduces economic growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95 for 2 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes where CPIAUCSL exceeds 210 (1982-1984=100), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 210, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment (PAYEMS) and increase in unemployment (UNRATE) for 3 consecutive months signals rapid labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings declines, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
